paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Tavla, in Rav’s name. (I did not find mention of this name; She'erit Yosef also does not list him.) I think “Rabbi Abba” is a scribal error and should read “Rav Tavla,” Rav’s student. Evidence of this is that Yuchasin does not list Rav Tavla, who in fact is mentioned many times in the Talmud.
